items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: The interviewee states: 'I was actually out of town and knowing all these guys from then on. I didn't know too many of the guys that were playing, see? I left pretty early there, which was 1926.' Harry McKeown is listed as a member of the brother's band in 1928, after the interviewee left.

ctx.x: I like Harry Hoffman's playing and very few people know him.
Well, Harry, Harry played on the same thing, same idea as, as, as, uh, Joe Benuti. Only Joe Benuti had brought it out first, you understand?
Yeah. So, that's just the way it worked out. And, uh, let me get back to, did you ever play much around Biloxi?
